description: List catalog entries added since a date, newest first, each with the date it was added and whether that date comes from our history or the entry's last check. Omit since for the latest additions. Save next_since and pass it as since on your next call to get only newer entries, instead of downloading the whole catalog again. The same list is published as RSS at /feed.xml and on /changelog. Default 50, max 200.

since.description: Only entries added after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (a full ISO timestamp is accepted)

name: whats_new
title: What's new in the catalog
